title: Template variable naming: prompts use {{retrospective_reviewer_persona}} not {{retrospective_reviewer_role_content}}
description: Qualitative rubric criterion 4 requires the Retrospective Reviewer Persona section to use {{retrospective_reviewer_role_content}}; the actual implementation uses {{retrospective_reviewer_persona}} following the established reasoning_reviewer_persona naming convention in all three prompt files and all four Rust rendering paths. Functionally correct and consistently applied but deviates from the spec's explicit template variable name.
proposed_resolution: Standardize template variable naming: either update the spec's qualitative rubric criterion to match the established convention ({{retrospective_reviewer_persona}}), or migrate all prompt files and Rust .replace() calls from {{retrospective_reviewer_persona}} to {{retrospective_reviewer_role_content}} for consistency with the spec.
